name: format_convert
description: Convert between JSON, TOML, INI and a YAML subset. TOML is read with tomllib and written as tables, arrays of tables, inline arrays and quoted keys; INI goes through configparser (case kept, no interpolation); YAML block mappings and sequences, scalars with YAML 1.2 core types, quoted strings, block scalars, single-line flow collections and comments are read and written here, and anchors, aliases, tags and multi-document streams are refused clearly. Each result is read back to check the round trip and lists what is lost.
